prior_importants.description: `docs/conventions/naming.md` line 76 says: "`utils` | **Pure functions only.** Cannot import `service`, `manager`, `repository`, or `client`. If it needs one of those, it isn't a util." The new file imports `./git-diff.client.js` (`runGit`, `rethrowIfKilled`), `./merge-gate.service.js` (`deleteBranchAt`, `isAncestor`, `newestMerge`, `resolveCommit`) and `./session.repository.js` (`getSession`). Its functions also run git and read the database, so they are not pure. The next maintainer will either break the util contract or have to move the file.

`RetireOutcome` is an exported interface declared in a `*.service.ts` and imported by `src/cli/index.ts`, against `docs/conventions/general.md` §Type separation (exported types live in `src/core/types/*.types.ts`).

findings.description: `pup retire` prints the stored merge event's `target` raw in the base-mismatch refusal (`not ${target}, the target ${id}'s PR was for.`); `pinnedPullRequest` only checks it is defined. `pup land` treats the same store text as untrusted and runs `assertTargetName(req.repoPath, target)` before printing it. A tampered merge row whose `target` holds control or bidi characters can never equal a GitHub `baseRefName`, so this refusal always fires and writes those bytes to the operator's terminal. Wrap it in `sanitizeReason(target)` (as `superseding.base` already is on the same line) or call `assertTargetName` after `pinnedPullRequest`, as land does.

The header says this file holds what `pup land` and `pup retire` share, including "the teardown of what the gate left behind", but it has no teardown function: it exports only `deleteBranchIfHeld`, `assertUnlockedWorktree` and `isRegisteredWorktree`, and each command keeps its own `tearDown`. A reader looking for a shared teardown here won't find one; reword to "the helpers each command's teardown is built from", or delete the header since the per-function JSDoc already covers it.

`isRegisteredWorktree` is a one-line wrapper over the private `worktreeEntry` with a single caller (`land.service.ts:432`). Exporting `worktreeEntry` (e.g. as `findWorktree`) and having land check `!== undefined` removes one exported function and its JSDoc.

`pup land` on a session whose PR is CLOSED still refuses with "is CLOSED on GitHub, not MERGED; merge it there first", and `pup ci wait` prints `moot, the PR is CLOSED → none`; neither points at the new `pup retire <id> --superseded-by <pr>`, which this PR makes the documented exit for exactly that state (LOOP.md), so the conductor relays advice to merge a closed PR.
